:::{#exm-norm-dot-product}
#### The length of a vector from its dot product

For $\vx = (3, 4)$ from @exm-euclidean-norm:

$$
\ba
\vx \cdot \vx
&= 3 \cdot 3 + 4 \cdot 4
&& \text{(@eq-inner-product)}
\\
&= 9 + 16
&& \text{(multiply)}
\\
&= 25
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

so @thm-norm-dot-product gives $\norm{\vx} = \sqrt{25} = 5$,
the same length that @exm-euclidean-norm found from @eq-l2-norm.

:::
